comparison.objective: Unbox, assemble, connect, and aim a camera system.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-part setup including tripod erection, mounting, cable insertion, and aiming.
comparison.success_condition: Camera is mounted, connected, standing at the marked spot, and aimed at the target; scoring thresholds are missing.
